aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Two decades after a scandalous breakup, the members of an iconic 2000s K-pop trio reunite for a chaotic comeback concert while confronting their past conflicts and eccentric present lives.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Twenty years after an exploitative producer and scandal tore apart the legendary 2000s K-pop trio Triangle, former leader Hyun-woo seeks out his estranged bandmates for a rare reunion concert. Rapper Sang-gu is now drowning in debt as an insurance salesman, while vocalist Do-mi lives trapped in a rigid high-society marriage, but both agree to give their musical dreams one final shot. Their journey to the venue quickly turns into a wild road trip full of absurd mishaps, unexpected encounters, and chaotic setbacks. Ultimately, the trio takes the stage to deliver a reinvented performance that reignites their passion and honors their long-lost friendship.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the early 2000s, the co-ed K-pop dance trio Triangle shot to instant stardom before their meteoric rise came to a sudden halt. A string of devastating setbacks—including an absconding producer, unpaid wages, and a damaging plagiarism controversy—forced the trio into a bitter disbandment. Two decades later, former leader Hwang Hyun-woo is struggling to stay afloat while holding onto his fading entertainment career. When an unexpected opportunity arises to perform at a major reunion concert, Hyun-woo embarks on a mission to track down his former bandmates. He finds former rapper Gu Sang-gu deeply in debt, while vocalist Byeon Do-mi is suffocating under the expectations of her wealthy in-laws. After persistent persuasion, the three agree to reunite and set off on a turbulent road trip to the concert venue. Chaos ensues along the way as they cross paths with rival singers and past foes, leading to wild car chases, traffic accidents, and near-disastrous rehearsals. Arriving at the venue just moments before showtime, the trio abandons their scripted nostalgic routine to present a modernized, energetic performance reflecting their true selves. The explosive performance captivates the audience and brings emotional closure to their lingering resentment from twenty years prior.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of first-generation K-pop nostalgia, Wild Sing follows the rise, fall, and chaotic resurgence of Triangle, a fictional co-ed dance trio that once dominated the music scene in the early 2000s. After a devastating combination of financial exploitation, scandal, and internal friction abruptly ended their peak era, the three members went their separate ways into vastly different lives. Twenty years later, Hwang Hyun-woo, the group's former breakdancing leader who is desperate to salvage his entertainment career, receives a once-in-a-lifetime chance to gather Triangle for a high-profile reunion gig. Reconnecting with Gu Sang-gu, a struggling insurance agent overwhelmed by debt, and Byeon Do-mi, a vocalist navigating the strict confines of a wealthy family, Hyun-woo must persuade them to take the stage once more. As the estranged trio sets out on an unpredictable journey to their comeback concert, they are forced to deal with absurd road obstacles, unresolved grievances, and the eccentricities of adulthood, leading to a heartwarming and hilarious exploration of second chances, friendship, and the enduring power of music.

story_structure.climax: With the curtain about to rise on the big show, a major setback threatens to unravel everything, forcing the trio to make a defining choice about their legacy and their commitment to one another.
story_structure.conflict: The women must navigate deep-seated personal grievances, lingering public scrutiny, and the stark reality of how much their lives—and the music industry—have changed since their heyday.
story_structure.resolution: Regardless of whether the performance goes perfectly, the three find a new sense of closure, reshaping their shared history and moving forward on their own terms.
story_structure.introduction: Twenty years after a high-profile scandal broke them apart, the three former members of a hit 2000s K-pop trio are approached for a high-stakes, one-night-only reunion performance.
story_structure.risingAction: As rehearsals begin, a cascade of practical and emotional hurdles emerges, forcing the group to confront past betrayals and modern logistical nightmares while attempting to regain their stage chemistry.
